title: Approve or reject and request changes to safety arrangement (Safety Officer)
note: Jira SPM-130 AC1-AC5 and approved Confluence matrix 36798526 / case pages 36733008, 36831261, 36700287, 36733026, 36831279 are authoritative. The 2026-11-01 user clarification requires Request changes to collect multiple rows, one independent feedback item per nonblank row; Confluence case 03 says description but does not specify row count. The UI sends changes:string[] and never splits free text; the API continues accepting legacy reason:string as one item. Approval stores approved, rejection stores rejected and a required reason, and request changes stores changes_needed. Rejection and request-changes feedback are collected in separate action-specific modals; opening, cancelling or closing a modal submits no decision and discards its draft. Approval stays direct and omits feedback. Successful decisions show a confirmation modal; exact confirmation wording is unspecified, so tests assert a modal with nonempty confirmation content.
